title: A very ample sheaf over an affine base is pulled back from projective space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a very ample invertible sheaf on a finite type morphism over an affine base is the pullback of the twisting sheaf along an immersion into a projective space. The proof unpacks very ampleness into an immersion into the projectivisation of a quasi-coherent module, rewrites that projectivisation as a Proj of a symmetric algebra, covers the image by finitely many standard affine opens using quasi-compactness and the finite type hypothesis, and then assembles the local embeddings into a single immersion into a projective space over the base.
